request.system: Assess whether the hypothesis or expression uses or tests numbered claims. Return JSON only: {"uses_claim": true|false, "claim_ids": []}. Return one bare JSON object without Markdown fences or commentary. uses_claim must be a JSON boolean. claim_ids must be an array of integer claim numbers, never quoted strings; use an empty array when uses_claim is false.
request.prompt: {"claims": {"1": "**Findings so far**", "2": "Our composition theme compares two employment-rate flow variables, V02 and V03.", "3": "Failure: ranking groups by the three-month rise in V02's share relative to V03 gave a negative information coefficient near minus 0.04, with a t-statistic of about minus 1.4.", "4": "It was weakest when the common index was low.", "5": "Reversing the mix to favor V03, lengthening to six months and restricting to low-index periods gave a positive coefficient near 0.05, with a t-statistic of about 1.9.", "6": "Caveats: coverage is only 58 percent, and there is no high-index evidence.", "7": "Rank persistence is low, near 0.22, and overlap with base factors is small.", "8": "Next, test robustness outside the low regime."}, "hypothesis": "A six-month rise in V03 relative to V02 signals a favorable flow composition. If the low-index result is genuine, this signal should also predict higher next-month relative returns during high-index periods.", "expression": "regime(chg(ratio(V03,V02),6),\"high\")"}
